verdict.rationale: Consensus is built as a scholarly search engine rather than an open-web tool. Its docs say it searches over 200 million academic papers, analyzes full text including paywalled papers from major publishers, and filters by study type, journal, year and discipline. A probe of llms.txt confirms the product describes itself as finding and ranking peer-reviewed research. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of corpus coverage and quality, and evidence of coverage for primary sources beyond journal papers (e.g. datasets, archives, preprints).
